description: Screen a wallet address (BTC, ETH/EVM, Solana, Tron, XRP, LTC) against OFAC sanctions and scam lists with on-chain context. tier=max adds the chain's own trail: a 2-hop Bitcoin trace with exposure, a Solana wallet's age and trading record, or a Base wallet's USDC counterparties. For tokens use token_check. Price: standard $0.02, max $0.10. Live; 2-20 s. Risk signals, not a legal finding. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.
name: address_check
title: Crypto address risk / AML screen
